critical_code_review_comments: platform_routes.provision_room: admin user is inserted BEFORE the room. If room insert fails (e.g., duplicate room_code after 10 tries), the admin user is orphaned. Wrap in try/except that deletes admin_user on room-insert failure, or insert room first then admin.
platform_routes._assemble_room does N+1 queries (per room: admin lookup + count_documents). Fine for small tenants but should use $lookup+$facet aggregation once room count grows.
room_routes._get_scoped_room re-fetches room + validates status on every /room/token call — good defense-in-depth.

db.migrate_to_3_role_model is idempotent as claimed. Note: step 2 deletes 'extra' rooms silently — logs a warning but doesn't cascade sessions/users, which could leave sessions with dangling room_id. Low risk (pre-migration data only).
admin_routes.remove_member correctly enforces cross-tenant isolation with role=='user' AND room_id==room.id check.
Suspend cascade only sets user.status=suspended; when un-suspending via PATCH status=active, users are also flipped back to active — verified by re-login after resume in tests.
